description: Representative Aaron Bean (R-FL) sat down with The Floridian to discuss the displays of antisemitism on college campuses in recent weeks and bashed the calls from the International Criminal Court (ICC) for the arrests of Israeli officials, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
